items.title: Identifying the terms of the Hom(Delta[1], L) coskeleton diagram
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Bookkeeping lemma for the homotopy machinery: identify Hom(Delta[1],L)_{n+1} = Hom(Delta[1] x Delta[n+1], L)_0 and (L x L)_{n+1} = Hom(Delta[n+1] coprod Delta[n+1], L)_0 (simplicial-lemma-exists-hom-from-simplicial-set-finite), the coskeleton terms as the same Hom groups into partial Delta[n+1] = i_n! sk_n Delta[n+1] (cited lemma combined with simplicial-lemma-cosk-shriek), and the fibre product of the bottom and right arrows of the diagram as Hom(U, L)_0 where U subset Delta[1] x Delta[n+1] is generated by the images of Delta[n+1] coprod Delta[n+1] and Delta[1] x partial Delta[n+1]; U equals their pushout along the common boundary by simplicial-lemma-hom-from-coprod.
